title.en: Combined Graduate Level Examination: Tier-II Paper-I
title.hi: संयुक्त स्नातक स्तरीय परीक्षा : टियर-II प्रश्नपत्र-I

source.title: Staff Selection Commission, Notice: Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026 (F. No. HQ-C11018/1/2026-C-1, uploaded 21-05-2026)
source.url_note: The file name on the SSC server says 'cgl_2025' but the document is the 2026 notice (header and every date say 2026).

duration_rules.break_between_sessions: re-registration break of unstated length (para 13.9.5.5, PDF p.28)
duration_rules.scribe_eligible: Section-I and Section-II: 1 hour 20 minutes each (40 minutes per subject in Section-I; 55 and 25 minutes in Section-II); Section-III and Section-IV: 20 minutes each; DEST gets 5 minutes compensatory time (table 13.9, PDF pp.25-27; para 13.9.10.7, PDF p.30)
duration_rules.source_ref: paras 13.9.5.1 and 13.9.5.6 (PDF p.28): Session-I is 2 hours 15 minutes, Session-II is 15 minutes, both on the same day

language_rules.paper_is_bilingual: Questions are set in English and Hindi except the English Language and Comprehension part of Section-II (para 13.9.7, PDF p.28).

section_navigation_source_ref: Paras 13.9.5.2-13.9.5.4 (PDF p.28): Section-I closes automatically after one hour, Section-II starts immediately and closes after one hour, Section-III starts immediately after. The order of the two subjects inside Section-I and Section-II is not stated beyond the A/B labels.

mcq_single.wrong_source_ref: para 13.9.8 (PDF p.29): 'negative marking of 1 mark for each wrong answer in Section-I, Section-II and Section-III of Paper-I'

sections.max_marks_source_ref: derived: Section-I is '60*3 = 180' for 30 + 30 questions (table 13.9, PDF p.25)

qualifying.source_ref: paras 16.1, 16.5 (PDF pp.41-42): every section of Paper-I must be qualified separately

qualifying.note: Qualifying in nature; a separate higher cut-off for posts where Computer Proficiency is prescribed (paras 13.9.9, 16.6, PDF pp.29, 42).

data_entry.task: one passage of about 2000 key depressions in 15 minutes (para 13.9.10.2, PDF p.29)

qualifying.note: Higher standards for posts where DEST or Computer Proficiency is prescribed (paras 13.9.10.4, 16.6, PDF pp.29, 42). PwBD-OH exemption rules in para 13.9.10.6 (PDF p.30).

key_anomaly_rules.tentative_key_challenge: Tentative answer keys are placed on the SSC website after the examination; representations are made online within the stated time on payment of Rs 100 per question, non-refundable (para 13.3, PDF p.24).
key_anomaly_rules.guidelines: Guidelines regarding Challenge / Objection Management System, SSC Notice dated 10.04.2026 (para 13.4, PDF p.24); not retrieved.
key_anomaly_rules.re_evaluation: No re-evaluation or re-checking of scores of any stage (para 13.7, PDF p.24).

scoring.normalization: Scores from multiple shifts are normalised by the procedure in the SSC Notice dated 02-06-2025 (para 13.2, PDF p.24).
scoring.merit: Merit for most posts is the aggregate of Section-I and Section-II of Paper-I (180 + 210 = 390 marks), subject to qualifying Section-III and Section-IV; JSO and Statistical Investigator Grade-II add Paper-II; Assistant Audit Officer and Assistant Accounts Officer add Paper-III and need only Section-III qualified; DEST-prescribed and Computer-Proficiency posts apply higher Section-III/IV standards (paras 16.11.1-16.14, PDF pp.42-43).

notes: interface 'ssc_tcs' and mode 'cbt': the notice says Computer Based Examination (para 13.1, PDF p.24) but does not name the test vendor or describe the screen, so 'ssc_tcs' is the skill's enum value for SSC CBTs, not a quoted fact.
instructions is null: the notice does not reproduce the instructions screen.
Paper-I is compulsory for all posts (para 13.9.2, PDF p.27) and runs in two sessions on the same day (para 13.9.5, PDF p.28).
Section-IV (DEST) is not multiple choice and carries no marks; it has its own error-percentage standard. Its language is recorded as English because the notice does not state it; see open_questions.
Per-subject maximum marks (90, 90, 135, 75) are derived from '3 marks x questions'; the notice prints the section totals 180, 210 and 60.
max_marks 450 includes the qualifying Computer Knowledge Test (60); merit_marks is 390.
Question level: Mathematical Abilities at Matriculation level, English Language and Comprehension at 10+2 level (para 13.11.8, PDF p.36).
open_questions: The notice is printed in English and Hindi (para 23(a), PDF p.48), but only the English notice was retrieved. Hindi titles here are translations (title_hi_source: translated); replace them with the official Hindi wording.
Normalisation of multi-shift scores follows the SSC procedure published in the Notice dated 02-06-2025 (para 13.2, PDF p.24). That notice was not retrieved, so scoring.normalization only names it.
The notice does not say whether a calculator (on-screen or physical) is allowed. calculator stays null.
Shift timings are not stated in the notice; they appear on the Admission Certificate. shift_timings stays null.
The number of options per question is not stated in the notice. options_per_question stays null.
The language of the DEST passage and how errors are counted are not in the notice; para 13.9.10.2 points to an evaluation note on ssc.gov.in ('For Candidates') that was not retrieved.
Tier-II dates: the notice only says 'December, 2026' (tentative). No dated Tier-II schedule notice was found.
